text: {"question": "What specific nephroprotective benefits do GLP-1 receptor agonists provide in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease?", "answer": "GLP-1 receptor agonists help slow down the progression of kidney disease and decrease albuminuria in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease.", "evidence": "These benefits include reductions in major adverse cardiovascular events, slowing of kidney disease progression (as measured by estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) decline), and decreased albuminuria."}
